meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,然后自动组建五名互相攻击的团队成员,让它们批判你的规划方案;之后只保留经得起攻击的结论,并强制把这些结论交给 plan 代理,由它写出可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词,或要求做对抗式/交叉批评规划时触发。需满足 team 工具可用、以 sisyphus 身份在主会话运行等前置条件。

say.text: hyperplan:帮我规划这个新功能,先让团队互相挑刺。
say.note: 会先宣告开启,再启动五名成员批判你的方案。

say.text: 用对抗式规划评估我的重构方案,指出薄弱假设。
say.note: 五个成员会分别从简化、集成、证据、架构、创意角度攻击。

say.text: hpp 做 API 迁移计划,重点查过度设计和遗漏边界。
say.note: 结束后会交给 plan 代理生成可执行计划。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', assembles five adversarial members who attack each other's findings on your plan, keeps only surviving insights, and mandatorily hands them to the plan agent for the final plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', etc., or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning. Prerequisites: team-mode tools, running as sisyphus in main session.

say_en.text: hyperplan: plan this new feature, have the team critique each other.
say_en.note: It announces start, then five members attack your plan.

say_en.text: Evaluate my refactor plan with adversarial planning; find weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Each member attacks from a different angle.

say_en.text: hpp: make an API migration plan, watch for over-engineering and edge cases.
say_en.note: Then the plan agent turns results into an executable plan.
